Sejal Anand <sejalanand@microsoft.com> wrote:
>  [Fonts] Fix Font matching after font-style & font-stretch updates
>

>  updates.
>  
>  This CL extends the same invalidation to font-style and font-stretch
>  descriptor setters so that subsequent font matching reflects the updated
>  values.
